title: CyberMatrix
tagline: A web 3 social platform based on Lens protocol with features like post, comment, mirror
description: I build a web 3 social platform on Polygon and Ethereum blockchains, it includes traditional social network features as follow, like, comment and mirror on top of Lens protocol, also contains live stream service with Web3 native vendor Livepeer, speed up the performance by using the Graph as the data pipeline.
how_its_made: I build this web 3 social platform in Solidity and Javascript on Polygon and Ethereum blockchains, ship features as follow, like, comment and mirror on top of Lens protocol, live stream service with Livepeer, using the Graph as the data pipeline, grab price info via the Chainlink.
